$comment: CE-4600 B-3 (docs/DESIGN_Vehicle_Breaching.md B-D3, B-D4, D-3, V-9, R-4238, R-4243) — what a PLAYER-DRIVEN vehicle breaks by contact. STARTING VALUES, to be tuned. The FIRST row (file order) the vehicle qualifies for decides: a TRACKED vehicle (if 'tracked') of at least minMassKg. A barrier's STRENGTH = its material's resistanceMmRhaPerM x thickness (m) x height (m) (a wall panel's, an obstacle box's short side x height). A SMALL barrier (a free wall, a fence, a hedge, an obstacle) of strength <= smallMaxStrength breaks by a RAM (the step's speed into it >= minRamSpeedMs) or a PUSH (full throttle held in contact for pushSeconds) and the vehicle drives on keeping speedKept of its speed (never zero); the cut is the hull's footprint across the wall at its crossing angle + cutMarginM each side, at least minDriveThroughM, from the wall's base to its top. A BUILDING wall breaks only for a row with 'building', by a ram only (the bump): a door-sized Passage bumpWidthM x bumpHeightM, the hull held outside. costHealth is the damage the breaking vehicle takes (0: none in v1, B-D12). A vehicle no row takes breaks nothing (wheeled vehicles).
